Gatekeeper vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM Gatekeeper marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate macOS software-trust policy — not a literal paste of US marketing:

门禁 / Gatekeeper

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 门禁 alongside the English term Gatekeeper when describing MDM-configured macOS Gatekeeper on enrolled fleet Macs. Apple documentation and Chinese IT admin materials also use Gatekeeper in English on technical mockups. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a Gatekeeper policy editor needs 门禁-friendly headlines; a benefit line may keep Gatekeeper when accurate to your English source.

已识别的开发者 (identified developers)

When MDM Gatekeeper workflows allow apps from identified developers but not unsigned software, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 已识别的开发者. Use when your gallery shows "Allow apps from identified developers" overlays or identified-developer enforcement toggles — distinct from 证书管理 Certificate Management SCEP vocabulary unless your frame shows cert enrollment specifically.

公证 / 公证票据 (notarization)

macOS Gatekeeper notarization enforcement — where Apple-notarized software passes assessment — maps to 公证 and 公证票据 on admin-console frames. Use when your English source markets notarization compliance panels, notarization ticket validation, or "Notarization enforcement" badges — not Managed Device Attestation hardware attestation.

系统策略 / spctl / syspolicyd

Technical mockups and admin docs may reference 系统策略, spctl, or syspolicyd — macOS Gatekeeper assessment mechanisms MDM may enforce through policy. Chinese IT admin materials may use 系统策略 on policy editor frames while keeping spctl in English on technical overlays where buyers expect Apple terminology.

仅 App Store / 允许来自身份不明开发者

When marketing frames emphasize App Store only vs anywhere settings, use concise zh-Hans benefit lines for 仅 App Store or 允许来自身份不明开发者 where accurate — aligned with whether your UX leads with restrictive App Store only policy or permissive anywhere settings on fleet Macs.

AppLocale FAQ

What is MDM macOS Gatekeeper and why does listing copy matter?

Gatekeeper covers MDM and Configuration Profile Gatekeeper payloads that configure macOS Gatekeeper on enrolled Macs — App Store only vs identified developers vs anywhere, identified-developer and notarization enforcement, spctl-style assessment, and syspolicyd-style evaluation. Marketing those workflows on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does MDM Gatekeeper auto-translate my China listing?

No. Gatekeeper payloads are runtime MDM workflows — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines that mention Gatekeeper, identified developers, notarization enforcement, or App Store only — rewritten from your English originals with terms like 门禁, 已识别的开发者, and 公证 where accurate.

How is this different from Application Firewall?

Gatekeeper listing copy markets macOS software source and notarization policy on enrolled Macs. Application Firewall listing copy markets allow or block incoming network connections and stealth mode. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature.

How is this different from Configuration Profiles or Managed Device Attestation?

Gatekeeper configures which software may run based on developer identity and notarization. Configuration Profiles distribute installable .mobileconfig payload files — Gatekeeper may ride inside a profile, but profile distribution is not the Gatekeeper-policy lead. Managed Device Attestation proves fleet hardware integrity. Each is a separate Apple MDM surface — do not reuse boilerplate across them.

How is this different from Managed Login Items or Certificate Management?

Gatekeeper controls software execution trust before launch. Managed Login Items govern macOS startup persistence at login. Certificate Management handles SCEP and identity certificate lifecycle. Do not lead Gatekeeper pages with login item or SCEP marketing unless your English source genuinely shows those on separate frames.

Does AppLocale configure MDM servers or deploy Gatekeeper payloads?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. MDM server deployment and Gatekeeper payload engineering are outside AppLocale scope. We rewrite how you describe existing Gatekeeper workflows on the store page — we do not enforce Gatekeeper rules on enrolled Macs at runtime.

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters. Keywords allow up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits but should stay concise — especially overlays that must fit on-device mockups.
